meta.title: Don’t Visit VIETNAM… Before Watching This! (Expenses & Travel Tips)
meta.description:
Don't travel Vietnam before watching this! 30 vital tips and travel advice for any travels to Vietnam to guide you on the perfect adventure 🇻🇳  Save 10% off your eSIM with the code DANEANDSTACEY here:  https://geni.us/W3jhC4 ⬇ Click MORE for all our Vietnam recommendations ⬇

There are so many amazing reasons to travel Vietnam, but the truth is - it’s also a really challenging and confusing country in a lot of ways, which unfortunately means there’s lots of potential planning mistakes, expensive oversights and things you need to know before even thinking about visiting.

In this Vietnam travel guide we're sharing a vital list of must know things for any trip that will save you a lot of time and hassle! 30 tips, split into 5 sections, lots of expenses, and at the end, the unexpected highlight or our travels and our number 1 tip to guide you on the best adventure!

comments.author: @justme1025
comments.text:
I am in Vietnam at the moment, for the third time. I agree with a lot of what is said here, except for the weather.

Vietnam in winter is very cold in the north, it gets warmer as you go south. But Hanoi is very cold, don't come in the winter expecting tropical temperatures.

Danang is warmer but still not very hot in winter.

Stick to Nha Trang and further south if you want really tropical weather in the winter.
